request.text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

The parties agree to keep things quiet.
request.name: N09

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: Confidentiality lasts no more than 3 years from signature.
findings.rationale: A longer obligation costs more to administer than it is usually worth, and is the term most often negotiated down.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: The agreement is governed by Indian law.
findings.rationale: A foreign governing law makes any dispute slower and more expensive to run.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: Exclusive jurisdiction sits with the courts of an Indian city where the company already operates.
findings.rationale: Exclusive jurisdiction somewhere the company has no presence turns a small dispute into a travel budget.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: The agreement defines what counts as confidential information.
findings.rationale: Without a definition there is nothing in particular being protected.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: The agreement contains a promise to keep the other side's confidential information secret.
findings.rationale: It is the operative promise, so its absence is the most consequential omission this document type can have.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: The agreement permits disclosure where it is required by law or by a court.
findings.rationale: Without that carve-out the receiving party is promising something it cannot perform.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: The agreement says what happens to the material when it ends.
findings.rationale: It is the clause people discover is missing at the end, when the material is already out.

findings.detail: the clause is absent, which is the standard
findings.rationale: A non-compete changes what an NDA does and is easy to miss inside one; whether a particular form is acceptable is a person's call, not code's.

findings.detail: the clause is absent, which is the standard
findings.rationale: Same as the non-compete: it changes what the document does, and whether the form is acceptable is a person's call, not code's.

findings.detail: the standard expects this clause and none was extracted
findings.standard_text: Liability is capped at no more than Rs 1 crore.
findings.rationale: An uncapped or very high cap is unusual on a mutual NDA, and this figure is exactly the kind a reviewing lawyer should replace with the company's own.

law_not_held.refusal: Indian Contract Act, 1872 (Parliament of India) is within scope — it covers formation, consideration, free consent, void and voidable agreements, restraint of trade, remedies for breach — but no instrument has been acquired, so nothing here can be decided. Nothing acquired. F12 reviews a contract against a COMPANY PLAYBOOK, which is a commercial standard and not a legal test. Any question about whether a clause is valid, enforceable or void reaches this body and is refused by name until it is held. This is a statement about what we hold, not a finding that no obligation applies.

Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (Parliament of India) is within scope — it covers arbitration agreements, seat and venue, interim relief, enforcement of awards — but no instrument has been acquired, so nothing here can be decided. Nothing acquired. Reached by the dispute-resolution clause of almost every commercial contract, which is why declaring it matters more here than its acquisition priority suggests. This is a statement about what we hold, not a finding that no obligation applies.

Stamp duty — Indian Stamp Act, 1899 and State amendments (State governments) is within scope — it covers instrument stamping on share transfers, debentures, agreements — but no instrument has been acquired, so nothing here can be decided. Declared with a warning: rates vary across 25+ States and Union Territories, so a single national answer is wrong by construction. Any answer here must be State-qualified or refused. This is a statement about what we hold, not a finding that no obligation applies.
